All — finalizing the routing rules and confirming thresholds. Implemented the following in HubSpot (view link below):

- MQL score cutoff: 70+ (points: company size, title seniority, product interest, partner_priority)
- Trial users: included if partner_priority=high or company_size>=1000
- Title equivalence: map Head/Senior titles to VP band for outreach templates
- Assignment: score 90+ -> AE assign; 70-89 -> SDR priority queue; below 70 -> nurture cadence (partner-sent nurture allowed)

HubSpot import complete. I tagged all CloudSight leads as Company: CloudSight Analytics and set a workflow to add the tag when new attendees come in from the partner CSV.

Replay: uploaded to our CDN — https://videos.redwood.com/replays/cloudsight-product-ops-2026-11-30 (public link, internal embed token attached).

Next actions: Tessa starts outreach today; Sean to review top 8 AE-assigns and let me know if any should be escalated to priority SDR-assisted intro.

Thanks — Aisha
